name: agent402
description: Agent402 is the payment and trust layer for agentic commerce: agents find, pay for and verify paid calls to Agent402, across x402 and MPP, with signed receipts on successful direct calls. 500+ ready tools on the same rails. Open-source MCP server and skill: pay per call in USDC over x402 or MPP, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools.

interface.shortDescription: Payment and trust layer for agent calls on x402 and MPP
interface.longDescription: One MCP server with 500+ tools: web search and rendering, PDFs and OCR, SEC filings, market and crypto data, and utilities. The agent finds a tool with catalog.find and pays for that one call in USDC over x402 or MPP, by card, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools. A failed x402 call is not charged; a payment that lands late is repaid after on-chain proof. Some calls are paid before they run; a failed one can be retried free with the same payment, or is refunded. Most tools are deterministic code; model-backed tools are marked as such.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent402.Tools to find a tool for this task and call it.
